summary: Read the entire markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-D, and verified all three estimates against the supplied 29-page PDF. Every recorded statistic, confidence limit, p-value and analyzed participant count matches its cited PDF page and the intended contrast. The LUAR-MUD and CISR H2a estimates compare between-writer similarity under post-editing versus unassisted writing; the CoLA estimate compares the linguistic acceptability of those human-produced outputs. PDF p. 13 confirms 81 retained participants, and p. 24 confirms that every participant completed both conditions, supporting 81 in each arm and 81 unique people. The requested outcome and design codes are supported. No additional eligible full-sample randomized assistance contrast or first-round-only result was found. The other analyses concern model-generated reference stages, changes in reference source, self-reports, subgroups, associations or model validation and are appropriately excluded. The paper does not establish the resampling units for these specific contrasts, so se_basis=unclear is appropriate. The negative CoLA effect and interval are transcribed correctly from p. 21 despite the prose describing greater acceptability with post-editing; the extraction already flags the unresolved subtraction order. Unprinted arm statistics and observation counts appropriately remain null.
